_설명: 심화 8과 비교구문 — 보기 순서만 섞여 있던 객관식을 손으로 새로 썼다. 묻는 것과 푸는 방법은 그대로 두고 문장과 보기를 바꿨다.

문항.포인트: 비교급 + than any other + 단수 명사
문항.prompt: <보기>의 (A)와 (B)에 들어갈 가장 적절한 단어를고르면?
body: <보기>
This is [[(A)]] than any other [[(B)]] of
art we had ever seen!
choices: great works
great work
greatest works
greater work
greater works
문항.explanation: than 앞에는 비교급을, any other 뒤에는 단수 명사를 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 어법상 올바르지 [[않은]]것은?
choices: The more I practice, the much I improve.
The deeper you dive, the darker it becomes.
The more you save, the richer you will be.
The harder you push, the faster it will move.
The more you read, the more carefully you should think.
문항.explanation: 뒤에도 비교급이 와야 하므로 the more로 써야 한다.

문항.prompt: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
body: 그 소년은 그의 형만큼 빨리 달릴 수 있다.
choices: The boy can run as fast as his brother.
The boy can run so fast as his brother.
The boy can run as faster as his brother.
The boy can run as fast than his brother.
The boy can run so faster as his brother.
문항.explanation: as와 as 사이에는 원급을 쓰며, 긍정문에서는 so를 쓰지 않는다.

문항.prompt: 밑줄 친 [[much]]와 쓰임이 같은 것은?
body: <보기>
Children ask questions [[much]] more often
than adults.
choices: I slept [[much]] longer last night.
I've got far too [[much]] to carry.
Take as [[much]] rest as you need.
She needs [[much]] time to finish it.
He was [[much]] admired by his students.
문항.explanation: <보기>의 much는 비교급을 강조한다. ①도 longer를 강조하고 있다.

문항.prompt: 다음을 영작한 문장으로 가장 적절한 것은?
body: 너보다 더 따뜻한 마음을 가진 사람은 없다.
choices: Nothing has a warmer heart you.
No one has a warmerer heart than you.
One has a warmer heart than you.
No one has a warmer heart than you.
No one has a most warm heart than you.
문항.explanation: ‘아무도 ~보다 …하지 않다’는 「No one + 비교급 + than」으로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 문장과 의미가 같은 것은?
body: The Nile is the longest river in the world.
choices: No river is longer than the Nile.
Every river is longer than the Nile.
Every river is as long as the Nile.
The Nile is as long as other rivers.
The Nile is not longer than other rivers.
문항.explanation: 최상급은 「No + 명사 + 비교급 + than」으로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다.

문항.prompt: 표현이 자연스러운 문장을 <보기>에서 있는 대로고른 것은?
body: <보기>
ⓐ Owen is the taller Junho.
ⓑ It rains less than last month.
ⓒ Hana is more tall than Yuna.
ⓓ My score is a lot better than yours.
ⓔ This coat is expensiver than the red one.
ⓕ The nurse is more gentle than you.
문항.explanation: ⓐ는 than이 빠졌고, ⓒ는 taller, ⓔ는 more expensive로 써야 한다.

문항.prompt: 의미가 [[다른]]문장 하나는?
choices: You are the bravest of all.
Everyone is as brave as you.
No one is braver than you.
There is no one as brave as you.
You are braver than any other person.
문항.explanation: ②만 모두가 똑같이 용감하다는 뜻이고 나머지는 네가 가장 용감하다는 뜻이다.

문항.prompt: 보기 문장과 의미가 같은 것은?
body: <보기>
The Pacific is the deepest ocean in the world.
choices: Any other ocean in the world is deeper than the Pacific.
No other ocean in the world is as deep as the Pacific.
The Pacific is not deeper than any other ocean in the world.
The Pacific is as deep as any other ocean in the world.
Any other ocean in the world is as deep as the Pacific.
문항.explanation: 최상급은 「No other + 명사 + as + 원급 + as」로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다.

문항.prompt: 다음 주어진 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?
body: 오늘 그녀는 어제보다 더 늦게 일어날 것이다.
choices: Today she is getting up late yesterday.
Today she is getting up late than yesterday.
Today she is getting up later than yesterday.
Today she is getting up more late than yesterday.
Today she is getting up more later than yesterday.
문항.explanation: late는 -er를 붙여 later로 쓰며 more를 함께 쓰지 않는다.

문항.prompt: 다음 중 나타내는 의미가 [[다른]]문장 하나는?
choices: This song is the most popular song of the year.
This song is more popular than any other song of the year.
No song is as popular as this song of the year.
Nothing is more popular than this song of the year.
No other song is less popular than this song of the year.
문항.explanation: ⑤는 이 노래가 가장 인기 없다는 뜻이 되어 나머지와 반대이다.

문항.prompt: 다음 주어진 우리말을 영어로 표현할 때 빈칸에들어갈 표현으로 올바른 것은?
body: 그 아이는 어른보다 더 조심스럽게 걷는다.
The child walks ____________ than the adult.
choices: more carefuler
most carefully
more carefully
most carefuler
more than carefully
문항.explanation: -ly로 끝나는 부사는 앞에 more를 붙여 비교급을 만든다.

문항.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 문장을 바르게 영작한 것은?
body: <보기>
그것은 이 방보다 3배 넓다.
choices: It is as large as three times this room.
It is larger three times than this room.
It is three times as large as this room.
It is as three times large as this room.
It is not larger three times than this room.
문항.explanation: 배수사는 as ~ as 앞에 두어 「배수사 + as + 원급 + as」로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장을 고르세요.
choices: It is the funniest story I've ever read.
It is the tallest tower I've ever climb.
He is the most kind man I've ever seen.
It was a very sad song I've ever heard.
It is the more exciting game I've ever played.
문항.explanation: 「the + 최상급 + (that) + 주어 + have ever + 과거분사」의 형태로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 중 문장의 의미가 [[다른]]하나를 고르세요.
choices: Owen has the fastest bike in his club.
No other boy has a faster bike than Owen in his club.
Owen has a faster bike than any other boy in his club.
No other boy's bike is as fast as Owen's in his club.
Owen has a fast bike as other boys in his club.
문항.explanation: ⑤는 다른 아이들과 비슷하다는 뜻이라 나머지와 다르다.

문항.prompt: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
body: 김연아는 한국에서 최고의 피겨 선수이다.
choices: Kim Yuna is a good figure skater in Korea.
Kim Yuna is a better figure skater in Korea.
Kim Yuna is the best figure skater in Korea.
Kim Yuna is a the best figure skater in Korea.
Kim Yuna is as good figure skater as in Korea.
문항.explanation: 최상급 앞에는 the를 쓰고 a와 함께 쓰지 않는다.

문항.포인트: as soon as possible = as soon as + 주어 + can
문항.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분과 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 것은?
body: She should send the report [[as soon as possible]].
choices: as soon as I can
as soon as I could
as soon as she can
as soon as you can
as soon as she could
문항.explanation: 문장의 주어가 She이고 시제가 현재이므로 as soon as she can으로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 것을 [[모두]]고르면?
body: A dictionary is the most useful book.
= A dictionary is more useful than
choices: most books
no other book
any other book
any more book
all the other books
문항.explanation: 「비교급 + than any other + 단수 명사」 또는 「than all the other + 복수 명사」로 쓴다.

문항.포인트: 배수사 + as + 원급 + as that of
문항.prompt: 다음 우리말과 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
body: 이 도시의 현재 인구는 20년 전의 인구의 대략 절반이다.
→ The present population of this city is ___________.
choices: as about half as 20 years ago.
about as half as 20 years ago.
about half as large as 20 years ago.
half as about large as 20 years ago.
about half as large as that of 20 years ago.
문항.explanation: 비교 대상이 ‘20년 전의 인구’이므로 that of를 넣어야 한다.

문항.포인트: one of the + 최상급 + 복수 명사
문항.prompt: 다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 [[어색한]] 것을 고르시오.
body: Owen ⓐ[[is]] ⓑ[[one]] ⓒ[[of]] ⓓ[[the fastest]] ⓔ[[runner]] in
the school.
문항.explanation: 「one of the + 최상급」 뒤에는 복수 명사가 오므로 runners로 써야 한다.

문항.prompt: 다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
body: I am not as tall as Owen.
= I am ___________ tall than Owen.
choices: much
more
little
less
least
문항.explanation: ‘~만큼 …하지 않다’는 「less + 원급 + than」으로 바꿔 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞지 [[않은]]것은?
body: This movie is _____ more exciting than
that one.
choices: very
far
even
much
a lot
문항.explanation: very는 원급만 강조하므로 비교급 앞에는 쓸 수 없다.

문항.prompt: 다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 [[어색한]] 것을 고르시오.
body: ⓐ[[One]] of ⓑ[[the oldest]] ⓒ[[temples]] ⓓ[[are]] ⓔ[[this]]
[[building]].
문항.explanation: 주어가 One이므로 동사는 단수형 is로 써야 한다.

문항.prompt: 다음 중 의미가 나머지와 [[다른]]것은?
choices: Health is the most precious.
Nothing is as precious as health.
Nothing is more precious than health.
There is nothing more precious than health.
No other thing is less precious than health.
문항.explanation: ⑤는 건강이 가장 덜 소중하다는 뜻이 되어 나머지와 반대이다.

문항.포인트: as soon as possible = as soon as + 주어 + can
문항.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분과 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 것은?
body: You'd better send the email [[as soon as possible]].
choices: as soon as I can
as soon as I could
as soon as you can
as soon as you could
as soon as you'd better
문항.explanation: 문장의 주어가 You이고 현재의 일이므로 as soon as you can으로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 것을 고르시오.
body: Text me as soon as possible.
→ Text me as soon as ______________.
choices: I can
I could
you can
you could
you can‘t
문항.explanation: 명령문이므로 듣는 사람 you를 주어로 하여 as soon as you can으로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
body: Copper is not as expensive as silver.
= Copper is _________ expensive than silver.
choices: much
more
less
little
least
문항.explanation: ‘~만큼 …하지 않다’는 「less + 원급 + than」으로 바꿔 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 것을 [[모두]]고르면?
body: I think that the cheetah is the fastest animal.
= I think that the cheetah is faster than ______.
choices: most animals
no other animal
any other animal
any more animals
all the other animals
문항.explanation: 「than any other + 단수 명사」 또는 「than all the other + 복수 명사」로 쓴다.

문항.포인트: 배수사 + as + 원급 + as those of
문항.prompt: 다음 우리말과 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
body: 이 회사의 올해 매출은 작년 매출의 대략 세 배이다.
→ This company's sales this year are
choices: as about three times as last year
about as three times as last year
about three times as large as last year
three times as about large as last year
about three times as large as those of last year
문항.explanation: 비교 대상이 ‘작년의 매출’이고 복수이므로 those of를 넣어야 한다.
